BL-1545 — test_bl1374_sync_merge_passengers.sh has been red on main since 2026-09-04 with no owner, and the BL-1374 feature file with it (its handler runs the test): case 01 greps the WHOLE own-paths map for the passenger file and trips on the `:excluded` report key BL-1389 added, and case 05 walks from the LIVE origin/main to a pinned tip that origin/main has since absorbed, so its range is empty and two absent checks pass vacuously; neither is a misattribution - the lib still delivers own.txt alone and still names BL-1296 alone with the base pinned; the test reads `:paths`, pins both ends of the live walk and asserts the range is non-empty, and proves each fixture root before mutating (it created a stray `tA` branch in the live repository under git bisect run's GIT_DIR)
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. FIRM: no production code changes - land_step_lib.bb alrea…
